items.title: 10.4 Magnetic field mein charged zarre ki harkat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.4 in the book's order (PDF 234-236), with the Fig. 10.8 reference correction, Example 10.3 and self-checks.

blocks.text: Hum dekh chuke hain ke uniform magnetic field ke perpendicular rakhe current wale conductor par force F lagti hai. Current asal mein electric charges ka bahao hai, to sawal yeh hai: kya magnetic field mein chalne wale akele charges par bhi force lagti hai? Jawab hai haan. Tajurbe batate hain ke magnetic field ke aar paar chalne wale charged particle (zarre) par force lagti hai. Yeh force hum current wale conductor ki misal se nikal sakte hain.
Lambai L ka ek conductor lein jis se waqt t mein N charged particles guzarte hain, har ek ka charge q hai. In ki harkat se conductor mein current I banta hai:
Yahan Q waqt t mein guzarne wala kul charge hai. Agar particles ki velocity v ho to conductor ke saath un ki velocity:

Yahan L̂ current ki simt mein unit vector (1 lambai wala simt batane wala vector) hai. Force ki simt is par munhasir hai ke charge q positive hai ya negative. L̂ hamesha current ki simt mein hota hai, jo positive charges ki harkat ki simt hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan Fleming ke rule ke liye 'Fig. (10.8)' ka hawala deti hai, magar Fig. 10.8 to Example 10.2 ke loop wali figure hai. Fleming ka left-hand rule Fig. 10.3 mein hai, is liye sahi hawala Fig. 10.3 hai.

items: Positive charge wala particle dotted lakeer ke saath kaghaz ki satah par field mein dakhil hota hai. Us par oopar ki taraf force lagti hai, is liye woh mud kar kham-daar (curved) raste par chalta hai (Fig. 10.10-a).
Negative charge wala particle neeche ki taraf lagne wali force se neeche mud jata hai (Fig. 10.10-b).

blocks.alt: Do hisse, neele cross batate hain ke B kaghaz ke andar hai. (a) Musbat charge +q baen se seedhi dashed lakeer par velocity v se dakhil hota hai; force F oopar hai aur rasta oopar mur jata hai. (b) Manfi charge -q isi tarah dakhil hota hai; force F neeche hai aur rasta neeche mur jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.10: (a) Musbat aur (b) manfi charge kaghaz ke andar wali magnetic field mein dakhil hote hue (kitab ki Figure 10.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: F = q v × B. Yahan v daen taraf aur B kaghaz ke andar hai, is liye positive charge par force oopar aati hai; negative charge par ulti, yani neeche. Force hamesha velocity ke perpendicular rehti hai, is liye speed nahi badalti, sirf simt badalti hai aur rasta daire ka hissa ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 10.3
blocks.problem: Ek electron (kitab mein ghalti se 'election' chhapa hai) 10⁴ m s⁻¹ ki speed se uniform magnetic field mein perpendicular dakhil hota hai. Field ke andar electron kis raste par chalega? (B = 2.5 Wb m⁻², m = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
steps: Electron par force: F = qvB sinθ
v aur B perpendicular hain, θ = 90°, sin 90° = 1, aur q = e, is liye F = evB
Yeh force hamesha v ke perpendicular hai, is liye yeh centripetal force (daire ke markaz ki taraf force) ka kaam karti hai aur electron radius r ke daire mein ghoomta hai:
Dono taraf ko v se taqseem karein: r = mv/eB
Qeematein rakhein: r = (9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg × 10⁴ m s⁻¹)/(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C × 2.5 Wb m⁻²)
Upar 9.11 × 10⁻²⁷, neeche 4 × 10⁻¹⁹, is liye r = 2.3 × 10⁻⁸ m
blocks.answer: Electron 2.3 × 10⁻⁸ m radius ke daire mein chalega.

blocks.prompt: Uniform magnetic field mein charged particle ke raste ka radius kis ke directly proportional hai (MCQ 10.2)? Kya uniform magnetic field chalte charged particle ki kinetic energy badalti hai (constructed response 10.5)? Electron aur proton ek hi velocity se field ke perpendicular phenke jayein; kaun zyada mudta hai (short question 10.7)?
blocks.explanation: r = mv/(qB), is liye r momentum mv ke proportional hai: option (b). Kinetic energy nahi badalti: magnetic force hamesha velocity ke perpendicular hai, is liye koi kaam (work) nahi karti; sirf simt badalti hai, speed nahi. Electron ka charge proton jitna magar mass bohat kam hai, is liye us ka radius r = mv/(eB) bohat chhota hai aur woh zyada tezi se mudta hai.

blocks.prompt: Proton 0.300 T ki field mein 45° par 10⁷ m s⁻¹ se dakhil hota hai; us ke gol raste ka radius nikalein (numerical 10.8). 15 kV se tez kiye gaye electrons 0.35 T field se guzarte hain; ek electron par sab se zyada force nikalein (numerical 10.2).
blocks.explanation: Sirf field ke aar paar velocity ka hissa, v sin45° = 7.07 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹, gol harkat banata hai: r = m v sin45°/(eB) = (1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ × 7.07 × 10⁶)/(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 0.300) = 0.246 m. Electron ki speed: ½mv² = eV se v = √(2eV/m) = √(2 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 15000/9.11 × 10⁻³¹) = 7.26 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹; sab se zyada force (θ = 90°) evB = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 7.26 × 10⁷ × 0.35 = 4.1 × 10⁻¹² N.

items: Lambai L ko waqt t = L/v mein paar karte N charges q: I = Nqv/L (10.8). F = I L × B (10.9) se F = Nq v × B (10.12), aur ek charge par F = q v × B (10.13), F = qvB sinθ (10.14): field ke aar paar sab se zyada, saath zero.
Positive aur negative charges ulti simton mein mudte hain (Fig. 10.10). Force v ke perpendicular hai: gol rasta r = mv/(qB), speed nahi badalti. Example 10.3: r = 2.3 × 10⁻⁸ m.
